status: defined_before_labeling; agency reviewers not yet appointed
independence: Two people label every case independently without reading model predictions or one another's labels. A distinct third person adjudicates all cases after comparing both submissions. Record stable person IDs, actual completion timestamps and independence attestations; do not invent them.
unit: One preserved candidate sentence, with neighboring extracted context and the original PDF/page. Approve segmentation only after checking the original. If the unit is incomplete or wrongly split, mark segmentation_approved false and request a new versioned corpus; do not silently exclude difficult cases.

labels.obligation_present: Whether the passage expresses an affirmative duty, prohibition or commitment, as wording. Permission or advice alone is false. This is not a legal-binding determination.
labels.actor: Shortest exact subject text identifying the actor responsible for the relevant duty/action; empty string if no actor is stated. Null means not labeled. Exclude a leading condition or legal citation from the actor unless part of its name.
labels.modality: prohibition, permission, obligation, advisory or none. When several appear, prioritize the prohibition for this sentence-level summary and explain other forms in notes. The corpus is a surface-wording extraction evaluation, not a legal interpreter.
labels.condition_present: Whether an explicit condition or applicability trigger qualifies the passage, including if/when/subject-to wording. Review semantic content, not just keyword presence.
labels.exception_present: Whether the passage or explicitly attached context states an exception. Inspect neighboring context and the original page.
labels.scope_changing_exception: An exception that changes who, what, when or under which conditions the duty applies. Must also set exception_present true. Mere incidental use of an exception word is insufficient.
labels.temporal_status: in_force, future, not_applicable or unknown. Check the exact provision, review-as-of date and reliable status evidence. Do not infer current law from a historical header or the computer's date. Unknown is valid and is counted separately in the report.
labels.binding_status: binding, nonbinding, conditional or unknown for the agency/action in scope. A document's filename or sampling tier does not establish legal force. Unknown is valid and is counted separately in the report. Record actual authority/checks in notes.
labels.notes: Explain disagreements, mixed actors/modalities, ambiguous scope and any supporting authority/status checks actually performed. Never turn a missing input into a verified conclusion.

severe_miss_definitions.missed_prohibition: Gold modality is prohibition and prediction does not report a prohibition candidate.
severe_miss_definitions.missed_scope_changing_exception: Gold marks a scope-changing exception and prediction omits exception presence, including an exception attached in neighboring context.
severe_miss_definitions.future_reported_current: Gold temporal status is future and the output presents it as an operative current duty. A mere candidate or unknown applicability is not a current-rule claim.
severe_miss_definitions.nonbinding_reported_binding: Gold binding status is nonbinding and the output presents it as binding. Advisory wording or an unresolved review candidate is not a binding claim.

limits: Sampling overrepresents rare modal types; results do not estimate prevalence across all state policy text.
The seven uploaded Georgia snapshots do not establish current primary-law coverage.
The SS-25-001 filename contains a PS-25-001 header; its policy sampling stratum is provisional.
Unknown temporal or binding labels are reported as unassessed cases, not successful status checks.
No language model or new analytical check is justified by unlabeled predictions. Expansion requires adjudicated material misses that existing rules cannot reasonably address.
